name: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Transformer-based Parameterization
definition: A method that tokenizes two to four images and their camera parameters, concatenates them, and passes them through a transformer block whose output tokens are decoded into Gaussian parameters.
summary: GS-LRM uses a Transformer to directly predict 3D Gaussian primitives from few images, eliminating per-scene optimization for fast, feed-forward reconstruction.
